quote_en: ‘light means of transport battery’ or ‘LMT battery’ means a battery that is sealed, weighs 25 kg or less and is specifically designed to provide electric power for the traction of wheeled vehicles that can be powered by an electric motor alone or by a combination of motor and human power, including type-approved vehicles of category L ... and that is not an electric vehicle battery;
obligation_vi: Phân loại pin xe máy điện ≤25 kg là LMT battery

quote_en: Producers shall register in the register referred to in paragraph 1. They shall to that end submit an application for registration in each Member State where they make a battery available on the market for the first time.
obligation_vi: Nhà sản xuất đăng ký vào sổ đăng ký nhà sản xuất trước khi bán

quote_en: the category, or categories, of batteries that the producer intends to make available on the market for the first time ... namely portable batteries, industrial batteries, LMT batteries, electric vehicle batteries, or SLI batteries, and their chemistry;
obligation_vi: Khai báo nhóm pin và hóa học pin khi đăng ký

quote_en: The financial contributions to be paid by the producer shall cover the following costs ... (a) costs of separate collection of waste batteries and their subsequent transport and treatment, taking into account any revenues obtained from preparation for re-use or preparation for repurposing or from the value of secondary raw materials ... (d) costs of data gathering and reporting to the competent authorities
obligation_vi: Đóng góp tài chính phải bù toàn bộ chi phí thu gom riêng + vận chuyển + xử lý + báo cáo (trừ doanh thu tái sử dụng/vật liệu)

quote_en: are modulated ... as a minimum by battery category and battery chemistry, taking into account as appropriate the rechargeability, the level of recycled content ... whether the batteries were subject to preparation for re-use, preparation for repurposing, repurposing or remanufacturing, and their carbon footprint
obligation_vi: Phí PRO điều chỉnh theo nhóm pin và hóa học pin (eco-modulation)

quote_en: producer responsibility organisations shall publish on their websites at least each year ... the information on the rate of separate collection of waste batteries, recycling efficiencies and the levels of recovery of materials achieved
obligation_vi: PRO công bố hằng năm tỷ lệ thu gom và hiệu suất tái chế

quote_en: establish a waste LMT battery take back and collection system; ... offer the collection of waste LMT batteries, free of charge ...
obligation_vi: Lập hệ thống thu hồi pin LMT thải và thu gom miễn phí từ điểm thu gom kết nối

quote_en: covers the whole territory of the Member State taking into account population size and density, expected volume of waste LMT batteries, accessibility for and proximity to end-users, not being limited to areas where the collection and subsequent management of waste LMT batteries is profitable.
obligation_vi: Mạng thu hồi phủ toàn lãnh thổ, không chỉ vùng có lãi

quote_en: at least the following collection targets of waste LMT batteries: (a) 51 % by 31 December 2028; (b) 61 % by 31 December 2031.
obligation_vi: Chỉ tiêu thu gom pin LMT 51% (2028) và 61% (2031)

quote_en: calculate the collection rate as the percentage obtained by dividing the weight of waste batteries, collected ... in a given calendar year ... by the average weight of such batteries that producers either make available on the market directly to end-users or deliver to third parties ... during the three preceding calendar years.
obligation_vi: Công thức tỷ lệ thu gom = khối lượng thu gom năm t / bình quân khối lượng bán 3 năm trước

quote_en: End-users shall be able to discard waste LMT batteries at collection points ... and shall not be charged or be obliged to buy a new battery or to have bought the LMT battery from the producers who set up the collection points.
obligation_vi: Người dùng trả pin miễn phí, không buộc mua pin mới, không phân biệt hãng

quote_en: Producers of SLI batteries, industrial batteries and electric vehicle batteries ... shall take back, free of charge and without an obligation on the end-user to buy a new battery, nor to have bought the battery from them ...
obligation_vi: Thu hồi miễn phí pin xe điện (ô tô) từ người dùng và điểm thu gom

quote_en: up-to-date data for the parameters for determining the state of health and expected lifetime of batteries as set out in Annex VII shall be contained in the battery management system of ... LMT batteries and electric vehicle batteries. ... Read-only access to the data ... shall be provided ... for the purpose of: ... (b) evaluating the residual value or remaining lifetime of the battery and capability for further use, based on the estimation of the state of health of the battery
obligation_vi: BMS lưu tham số SoH và tuổi thọ; bên mua hợp pháp được đọc để đánh giá giá trị còn lại

quote_en: For stationary battery energy storage systems and LMT batteries: ... the remaining capacity; ... where possible, the remaining power capability; ... where possible, the remaining round trip efficiency; ... the evolution of self-discharging rates; ... where possible, the ohmic resistance ... the number of full equivalent charge-discharge cycles.
obligation_vi: Tham số SoH của pin LMT: dung lượng còn lại, công suất, hiệu suất, tự xả, điện trở; tuổi thọ: ngày sản xuất, thông lượng năng lượng, sự kiện bất lợi, số chu kỳ tương đương

quote_en: evidence of a state of health evaluation or state of health testing ... in the form of a copy of the record confirming the capability of the battery to deliver the performance relevant for its use following preparation for re-use or preparation for repurposing; ... further use of the battery ... is documented by means of an invoice or a contract for the sale or transfer of ownership
obligation_vi: Pin chuyển đời thứ hai phải có hồ sơ đánh giá SoH và hợp đồng/hóa đơn chuyển giao

quote_en: An economic operator that makes available on the market for the first time ... a battery that results from preparation for re-use, preparation for repurposing, repurposing or remanufacturing operations shall be considered to be the producer of such battery ... and shall have extended producer responsibility.
obligation_vi: Đơn vị đưa pin đời thứ hai ra thị trường trở thành nhà sản xuất mới và chịu EPR

quote_en: recycling of 65 % by average weight of lithium-based batteries [by 31/12/2025]; 70 % [by 31/12/2030] ... 50 % for lithium [by 31/12/2027]; 80 % for lithium [by 31/12/2031]; [cobalt, copper, lead, nickel: 90 % by 2027, 95 % by 2031]
obligation_vi: Hiệu suất tái chế pin Li 65% (2025) → 70% (2030); thu hồi Li 50% (2027) → 80% (2031); Co/Cu/Pb/Ni 90% → 95%

quote_en: recycling of 75 % by average weight of lead-acid batteries; [80 % by 31 December 2030]
obligation_vi: Hiệu suất tái chế ắc quy chì 75% (2025) → 80% (2030)

quote_en: Producers of portable batteries and producers of LMT batteries ... shall report to the competent authority, for each calendar year ... (a) the amount ... made available on the market for the first time ... (c) the amount of waste ... LMT batteries collected ... (d) the collection rate ... (e) ... delivered to permitted facilities for treatment; (f) ... exported to third countries ... (g) ... delivered to permitted facilities for preparation for re-use or preparation for repurposing.
obligation_vi: Báo cáo năm theo hóa học và nhóm pin: lượng bán · thu gom · tỷ lệ thu gom · giao xử lý · xuất khẩu · giao tái sử dụng/đời thứ hai

quote_en: From 18 February 2027 each LMT battery, each industrial battery with a capacity greater than 2 kWh and each electric vehicle battery placed on the market or put into service shall have an electronic record (‘battery passport’).
obligation_vi: Mỗi pin LMT/xe điện có battery passport

quote_en: The battery passport shall be accessible through the QR code ... which links to a unique identifier that the economic operator placing the battery on the market shall attribute to it. The QR code and the unique identifier shall comply with the ISO/IEC standards 15459-1:2014 ... 15459-6:2014 or their equivalent.
obligation_vi: Mã định danh duy nhất theo ISO/IEC 15459 gắn với QR

quote_en: For a battery that has been subject to preparation for re-use, preparation for repurposing, repurposing or remanufacturing ... Such battery shall have a new battery passport linked to the battery passport or passports of the original battery or batteries. Where the status of a battery changes to that of a waste battery, the responsibility ... shall be transferred either to the producer or ... the producer responsibility organisation, or the waste management operator
obligation_vi: Pin đời thứ hai có passport mới liên kết passport gốc; khi thành chất thải chuyển trách nhiệm dữ liệu cho producer/PRO/đơn vị xử lý

quote_en: A battery passport shall cease to exist after the battery has been recycled.
obligation_vi: Đóng passport khi pin đã tái chế

quote_en: information on the state of health of the battery pursuant to Article 14; ... information on the status of the battery, defined as ‘original’, ‘repurposed’, ‘re-used’, ‘remanufactured’ or ‘waste’;
obligation_vi: Passport lưu SoH và trạng thái pin (original/repurposed/re-used/remanufactured/waste)

quote_en: Any natural or legal person that places on the market products incorporating LMT batteries shall ensure that those batteries, as well as individual battery cells included in the battery pack, are readily removable and replaceable by an independent professional at any time during the lifetime of the product.
obligation_vi: Pin LMT và cell tháo/thay được bởi thợ độc lập

quote_en: [‘18 August 2025’ is replaced by ‘18 August 2027’] From 18 August 2027, economic operators that place batteries on the market or put them into service shall fulfil the due diligence obligations ...
obligation_vi: Thẩm định chuỗi cung ứng (Co, graphite tự nhiên, Li, Ni) từ 18/8/2027

quote_en: From 18 August 2028 or 24 months after the date of entry into force of the delegated act ... electric vehicle batteries and SLI batteries that contain cobalt, lead, lithium or nickel in active materials, shall be accompanied by documentation containing information about the percentage share of cobalt, lithium or nickel that is present in active materials and that has been recovered from battery manufacturing waste or post-consumer waste ... The first subparagraph shall apply from 18 August 2033 to LMT batteries
obligation_vi: Công bố hàm lượng tái chế: pin xe điện từ 18/8/2028 (hoặc muộn hơn theo văn bản ủy quyền); pin LMT từ 18/8/2033

quote_en: End-users shall discard waste batteries separately from other waste streams ... in designated separate collection points set up by, or in accordance with the specific arrangements concluded with, the producer or a producer responsibility organisation
obligation_vi: Người dùng cuối phải thải pin riêng tại điểm thu gom chỉ định
